correctness.rationale: Primary compact Aluthge spectral theorem supplies fixed-coordinate convergence and weak log-majorization. The proof derives a geometric-mean envelope, shows it lies in every finite Lorentz sequence space using AM--GM with r=p/2 and a dyadic weighted Hardy inequality, and obtains norm convergence of rearranged differences by dominated convergence. Little weak follows from vanishing Hardy tails. The explicit polynomial-weight shift has exact binomial weights, is compact/quasinilpotent and has invariant weak quasi-norm 1 while op norm vanishes. Finite checker verifies representative arithmetic, not the infinite claim.
